mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 39 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library under a First Quarter moon. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has two main updates for you. The Public Works Department is available for street and utility maintenance, and you can stay informed by subscribing to the city's digital newsletter which lists all current city programs.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia.

In our police report for the week, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle for a report of a domestic disturbance where a man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
It is a great day to visit Culver's. Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
